meta.notes: The bazaar row: a quiet level for one. Two blocks of shops between a lit street and a back alley; a patrol walks round each block and both come down the passage between them. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts bazaar

starts.name: behind the alley wall, by the gable

response.why: A market street in a town under curfew: the only armed men out at night are the patrol, and gunfire in the bazaar is the one thing they are out for.
